transfer.rationale: ST5 R4b checkpoint (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run before the move; reported with this commit under the operator's 2026-10-06 instruction to finish Settings with self-verification). App-to-hook transfer of the shared-config snapshot, aggregates and save orchestration (768 range lines in seven ranges) into settings/useSharedConfigSave.js with the plan's state layer: useSharedConfigSaveState (0 inputs, 12 returns: the settingsSaveInFlightRef, revision state and ref, conflict state, readiness and read-fence cells that every earlier section hook takes as inputs, so it must be called before them) and ONE save hook useSharedConfigSave (123 inputs, 154 expanded, 11 returns) holding the aggregates (isGroupDraftDirty, groupConfigValidationErrors, saveBlockedReason, the unsaved-section counters), buildSettingsSaveOutcome, saveGroupsConfig, saveAllSettingsOnce, saveAllSettings, the restore and return handlers, the keep-mine, discard-mine and use-latest handlers and applySharedConfigBootstrap (the ten shared-config statements of loadConfig), called at the old aggregates position. It has no effect, so nothing crosses. The imperative save sequence is moved verbatim (only the five permission writes differ, as R4a changed them): no table-driven rewrite, because a { id, isDirty, save } table would have to encode the revision-commit-versus-internal-commit split, the fixed adminAccess step, the field-config commits and the first-run committed-section tracking, and would change the order-sensitive control flow this extraction promises to leave alone. The plan's separate aggregates layer was measured and rejected: the aggregates alone need 32 inputs and about 60 extra lines to avoid one getter. Three getters, all read only inside handlers, supply loadSprints, loadConfig and activeDepartmentSettingsTab; placing the hook at the orchestrator's old position fails lint and hits a first-render TDZ. The ten ADMIN_SETTINGS_TAB_IDS-style tab sets move to a 3-line settingsTabIds.js module that App and the hook share. The loadConfig draft-guard prelude and fallback branch stay in App; only the ten sharedConfig statements move. The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 334-line scaffolding allowance. The dashboard.jsx lineCeiling stays 11649 until the slice's R5. The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
